title: micromeria croatica f. glabrata
intro: Micromeria croatica f. glabrata, commonly known as Mountain savory, is a subspecies of the Micromeria genus, a group of flowering plants in the mint family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits such as antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Micromeria croatica f. glabrata include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been isolated and studied for their medicinal properties.
